stem.text: Lysosomes vary in shape and size, making them difficult to identify.

A.text: a vesicle containing enzymes, enclosed by a double membrane, that is budded off the endoplasmic reticulum

B.text: a vesicle containing hydrolytic enzymes and surrounded by a single membrane, found only in phagocytes

C.text: a vesicle enclosed by a single membrane, containing several different hydrolytic enzymes that may act inside or outside the cell

D.text: a vesicle surrounded by a double membrane, containing enzymes which can hydrolyse damaged organelles in a cell
